subject: Coordinating a timeboxed group demo for logistics + ops teams
messages:

To: marcus.lin@redwood.com
Cc: tom.hale@dataforge.io, calendar+acme@calendar.com
Date: Mon, 18 Sep 2028 13:12:00 -0400
Subject: Group demo request — ops + logistics (30m timebox)?

Hi Marcus,

Thanks for the intro from Tom — we have a small group of three teams at Acme (Carrier Ops, Warehouse, and SRE) who want a concise, focused demo of Redwood’s inference workflow for routing and forecasting. We’re aiming for a strict 30-minute timebox so we can share the session across the org.

Key asks:
- 15 minute walkthrough of a routing/forecasting prompt + model variant choices
- 10 minute Q&A focused on integration and security (SOC2 questions may pop up)
- 5 minute next steps + mutual action plan

Available windows next week: Tue 9/19 10—11am ET, Wed 9/20 3—5pm ET, or Thu 9/21 1—2pm ET. We can do video + brief shared calendar invite.

If those work I’ll copy the internal stakeholders and lock it in.

Thanks,
Amina
Amina Rahman
Director, Strategic Ops — Acme Logistics

Hi Amina — great to meet you electronically, and thanks Tom for the intro.

We can absolutely do a tight 30-minute timebox and focus on the exact sequence you outlined. To make this smooth I propose the following:

Option A (preferred) — Tue 9/19 10:30–11:00am ET
Option B — Wed 9/20 3:30–4:00pm ET
Option C — Thu 9/21 1:00–1:30pm ET

I’m looping in Lauren (solutions lead) and Ben (product demos) to confirm hosts and which deck to use. I’ll also attach a short deck and a Calendly poll so we can lock the final time.

Quick logistical notes:
- We’ll keep the demo single-hosted (Ben) with a short security slide Lauren will cover.
- We’ll record but keep recording internal to attendees only unless you approve distribution.

Attachments: redwood-timebox-demo-deck.pdf, calendar-poll-link.txt

Looking forward — I’ll hold the preferred slot for 24 hours while you confirm.

Best,
Marcus Lin

Marcus / Amina — quick note from our side:

- Ben will run the demo and cover the routing example; I’ll take the three-slide security & integrations block.
- Ben, please prepare the 2-minute live prompt example (routing -> top-K variants) and have the small sample dataset preloaded.
- Marissa, can you attach the short runbook for the meeting (host responsibilities + recording consent) to the calendar invite?

A few timezone cautions for cross-site attendees: if anyone is joining from APAC we should avoid late ET slots — the Wed afternoon slot may be best for them. Amina, if you can tell us whether attendees are mostly US-only or distributed, we’ll favor the appropriate option.

Thanks — I’ll stand by to finalize after you pick a slot.

— Lauren
